column1: # The red run: this tree's assertions against the engine the base ref holds,
# written whole by tests/red, which tests/run --record-assertions calls.
#   base  <ref>  <sha>  <engine version there>
#   run   <failed>  <passed>  <skipped>        lines counted, not the summary
#   <assertion name>  <times it failed>        failed names only
#   an assertion the manifest lists that the base run never reached counts as failed, by its shortfall
# A base of - means no complete red run was made: none was possible, the
# suite stopped before reached or reached no assertion, or tests/red itself
# was stopped; its stdout said which unless it was the one stopped.
# Reproduce with: tests/red <ref>
base
run

tmdr: case 1, one deleted: when the candidate deletes d/k and renames the rest of d/ into e/, _felix_merge_refs exits 0 and names a tree with d/new at d/new in main's bytes, no e/new, and the renamed files at e/
tmdr: case 1: from the checkout of a candidate that renames all of d/ into e/ while main added d/new, _felix_merge_refs with base main exits 0 and prints main^{tree} and the id of a tree
tmdr: case 1: in the tree _felix_merge_refs names for that candidate, d/new is at d/new with main's bytes
tmdr: case 1: in the tree _felix_merge_refs names for that candidate, e/new does not exist
tmdr: case 1: in the tree _felix_merge_refs names for that candidate, the files it renamed are at e/ with its bytes, the nearly unchanged one included, and not at d/
